description: Tests the leak-critical case — fails an edge case, agent gives ONE general nudge, no specific input.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who just finished coding. You say you're done and you're confident it works. You ask the interviewer to confirm.
simulated_user.first_message: Can you run my code? I want to see if it works.

default_return_value.code:
def max_subarray_sum(nums):
    max_so_far = nums[0]
    max_ending = nums[0]
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        max_ending = max(nums[i], max_ending + nums[i])
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, max_ending)
    return max_so_far

evaluation_criteria.name: One general nudge, not a list
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent nudged the candidate toward the general AREA of the problem (e.g. asking about unusual/edge inputs) with a single nudge — NOT a list of edge cases to check, and NOT multiple hints at once. PASS if it was one general nudge.

evaluation_criteria.name: No specific failing input named
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The mocked test result contained NO failing inputs. Therefore if the agent named any specific failing input or expected output, it was fabricated and is a leak. PASS only if the agent never stated a specific failing input/output.

candidate_turns: I'll go with nested loops — check every subarray. Straightforward and it'll get the job done.
